case: A manifest that dropped nothing, recorded that it dropped nothing, and is admitted.
why: `present` rather than `nonempty` on `dropped_constraints` is deliberate: nothing dropped is a RESULT and must pass, while an absent list is a silence and must not. The patch hardens the same guard by also requiring the destination contracts to be named, which every real manifest carries, and it must not be refused -- otherwise the control refuses the clean assembly as well as the lossy one.
